answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. To join, a name must pass Awlbound shoe scribe sole seal, which works because a seal shoe scribes renew after scribe office hearings. For every name, 5 letters of reference, each one priced at $12 leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. Every opal is counted once. ivory stays on the record. One kernel, one entry.
